sections.title: Research Paper Writing
sections.description: For doctoral candidates who use English as a Second Language, this course explores expectations of academic writing at the graduate level as well as distinctive features of academic discourse and argumentation. Attention also is given to elements of formal written English such as grammar, clarity, conciseness, and coherence.
